subject: Zenith Health: Marketplace private offer MAP & evaluation milestones
messages:
From: Emma Chang <emma.chang@zenithhealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@zenithhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Aug 2028 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Kickoff: MAP + Private Offer for Redwood (Zenith Health)

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the chat earlier — procurement and IT want to lock down the mutual action plan (MAP) and confirm how the marketplace private offer will flow through our finance systems. High level asks from our side:

- MAP with milestones, owners, and acceptance criteria for evaluation (security, perf, integration).
- Confirmation of private offer path: will this be an AWS Private Offer or direct vendor PO/invoice? We need the billing path documented for our AP team.
- Draft PO language that references SOC2 evidence and data residency options.

Can you send a one-pager MAP and a sample PO draft we can share with procurement? Our target is to complete procurement approvals and issue a PO by Aug 28 so we can get the private offer executed in September.

Thanks,
Emma
Emma Chang
Sr. Procurement Manager, Zenith Health
emma.chang@zenithhealth.com
Procurement | Zenith Health

Attachment: zenith_rfp_summary.pdf (reference)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Emma Chang <emma.chang@zenithhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 9 Aug 2028 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: MAP + Private Offer for Redwood (Zenith Health)

Hi Emma — attaching the suggested MAP spreadsheet and a draft PO for procurement to review. High level summary below and proposed owners/dates.

Quick summary (proposal):
- Evaluation window (Milestone 1): 2 weeks (Aug 10–Aug 24) — test harness, perf targets, sample integration. Owner: Karthik Iyer. Acceptance: 3rd-party perf report + pass on core prompt regressions.
- Security review (Milestone 2): SOC2 evidence + architectural walkthrough (Aug 15–Aug 25). Owner: Laura Bennett. Acceptance: SOC2 doc + short security questionnaire closed.
- Commercial & Billing (Milestone 3): Private Offer path & invoice flow clarified (Aug 16–Aug 28). Owner: Ben Carter. Acceptance: PO issued by Zenith and private offer configured or vendor invoice path agreed.
- Go/no-go & PO issuance (Milestone 4): Final approval (target Aug 28). Owner: Emma/Procurement.

Marketplace options (short):
- AWS Private Offer: preferred for quick marketplace invoicing — Redwood can accept offer and invoice through AWS (Zenith receives marketplace invoice). Billing path: private offer acceptance -> AWS billing -> Zenith pays AWS -> AWS remits to Redwood per marketplace terms.
- GCP/Azure: similar private offer options exist but often require marketplace listing + private pricing setup; lead time can be longer (we've seen 2–3 weeks extra).
- Direct vendor PO/invoice: Redwood can accept a standard PO and invoice directly; procurement should confirm whether their AP requires marketplace invoice matching to pay via their hosted procurement portal.

Attached files:
- zenith_map.xlsx (MAP with task-level owners & dates)
- zenith_po_draft_20280814.pdf (sample PO language including SOC2 and data residency clauses)

Next steps:
1) Ben: confirm preferred billing route (AWS private offer vs vendor invoice) and list any required invoice fields.
2) Laura: attach SOC2 snapshot and schedule a 30-min security walkthrough for Aug 17.
3) Emma/Procurement: confirm internal target sign-off date (we proposed Aug 28).

Happy to hop on a 20-min call to walk through the MAP tomorrow if it helps.

—
Karthik Iyer
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Attachment: zenith_map.xlsx, zenith_po_draft_20280814.pdf

From: Marco Ruiz <marco.ruiz@zenithhealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Emma Chang <emma.chang@zenithhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Aug 2028 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: MAP + Private Offer for Redwood (Zenith Health)

Karthik — thanks for the detail. Procurement here had a couple questions after reviewing the PO draft and MAP: 

- Can you provide a short paragraph we can drop into our PO language stating the billing flow for an AWS Private Offer vs direct vendor invoicing? Procurement needs the exact wording for their template (who invoices whom, remit-to, and whether AWS invoice is the primary invoice for AP).
- We also need a line item that references your SOC2 attestation and a pointer to where our security team can pull short-lived evidence (SAML, attestations).
- Pricing anchor: can you confirm whether the private offer will be for a monthly commitment or an annual reserved capacity? They prefer a single-PO monthly cadence if possible.

If you can send the short paragraphs and confirm billing cadence by EOD Friday (Aug 18), we can route the PO internally and aim to issue by Aug 28.

Thanks — Marco
Senior Buyer, Zenith Health
procurement@zenithhealth.com

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Aug 2028 15:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: MAP + Private Offer for Redwood (Zenith Health)

Looping back after internal sync — next actions and owners: 

- Billing paragraph: Ben to draft two short snippets (AWS Private Offer wording + Direct vendor invoice wording) and post to the shared MAP doc by EOD 8/22.
- PO cadence: Redwood can support monthly PO (recurring) and annual reserved commitments. Ben to confirm pricing anchor and include an example invoice field list (PO#, remit-to, tax IDs) for Zenith AP.
- Security evidence: Laura to provide SOC2 summary link and schedule the walkthrough on Aug 23 (30 min).
- DocuSign readiness: if procurement signs the PO and needs DocuSign, Karthik to coordinate signature flow.

I'll attach the billing snippets here for review and will update the zenith_map spreadsheet with item-level owners.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Commercial Operations, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
